chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

About a man who gives the adhan while walking, while he is not in a state of taharah, or while he is on the back of a riding animal. He said: “Yes, if the one pronouncing the testimony faces the qiblah, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.الْمُتَشَهِّدُ: the one pronouncing the testimony of faith in the adhan
key_terms.ظَهْرِ الدَّابَّةِ: the back of a riding animal
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: gives the adhan, calls people to salat

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to give the adhan while walking, riding, or without taharah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the adhan. It indicates that giving the adhan while walking, without taharah, or while riding is permissible, provided that during the tashahhud portion one faces the qiblah.
